paper_policy_paraphrase: Evidence should be concise, interpretable in context and comprehensive for redundant evidence; this is not a blanket requirement to add every background premise. The authors describe example-oriented annotation and coverage-focused merged annotations.

(iii) to purchase, directly or indirectly, “solicit", or participate or join with any Person in the “solicitation" of, any “proxies" (as such terms are defined in the Securities Act (Alberta)) to vote, to seek to advise or to influence any Person with respect to the voting of any voting securities of the Disclosing Party;

confirmed_annotation_relative_exclusion_.actual_inspection: Inspect the full document for four distinct operative controls. Agreement confidentiality requires a nondisclosure duty covering the agreement or its existence or terms, or the existence, content, status, or terms of discussions or negotiations; when coverage comes from a protected-information definition, retain both that definition and the governing secrecy duty. Ordinary references to an agreement or transaction are missing support. Compelled-disclosure notice requires legal, regulatory, governmental, subpoena, court, or administrative compulsion to trigger notice, information, or consultation to the disclosing party; retain timing, legal-permission qualifications, and any protective-order mechanism. Unauthorized-use notice or bare compelled-disclosure permission does not suffice. No-solicitation requires the receiving party to refrain from soliciting identified personnel or representatives; retain target class, action, duration, consent condition, and exceptions, and exclude proxy solicitation or unrelated standstill language. Reverse engineering requires an operative prohibition on the receiving party reverse engineering, decompiling, or disassembling an object embodying protected information; general secrecy, copying, product-use, or intellectual-property language is not equivalent. An express affirmative authorization would be opposing evidence, but no located clause or candidate is only missing support. For every issue retain necessary preambles and independently operative responsive provisions, and do not treat examples or candidate retrieval as proof of whole-document absence.
